Lucas Martin  
Email: lucasmartin@email.com | Phone: (555) 123-4567 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/lucasmartin | GitHub: github.com/lucasmartin  

Professional Summary  
Recent graduate with hands-on experience in healthtech data analysis and machine learning. Focused on leveraging Python, cloud platforms, and NLP to improve healthcare outcomes. Internships at MedTech Corp and HealthData Solutions provided foundational skills in model development, data pipeline design, and API integration. Currently contributing to scalable ML systems at HealthAI Innovations.  

Professional Experience  
**Junior Machine Learning Engineer**  
*HealthAI Innovations* | 2024–Present  
- Developed a predictive model for patient readmission risk using scikit-learn, achieving 82% accuracy in validation.  
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate REST APIs for real-time data ingestion, reducing latency by 25%.  
- Streamlined ETL processes for clinical datasets using AWS Glue, improving data readiness for analysis.  
- Experimented with PyTorch to build a custom neural network for medical image classification, achieving 78% F1 score.  
- Supported deployment of models on AWS SageMaker, ensuring compliance with HIPAA standards.  

**Machine Learning Intern**  
*HealthData Solutions* | 2023  
- Built a natural language processing pipeline using Hugging Face Transformers to analyze unstructured clinical notes, improving keyword extraction efficiency by 30%.  
- Designed a TensorFlow-based model to predict patient discharge dates, contributing to a 15% reduction in manual data entry.  
- Partnered with data engineers to optimize data warehousing workflows, reducing query response times by 40%.  
- Created a dashboard for tracking model performance metrics using Python and Tableau.  

**Data Analyst Intern**  
*MedTech Corp* | 2022  
- Conducted exploratory data analysis on 500k+ patient records, identifying key trends in treatment efficacy.  
- Built a Python script to automate data cleaning, saving 10+ hours weekly for the team.  
- Collaborated on a project to enhance data visualization for stakeholders, using SQL and Power BI.  

Education  
**Bachelor of Science in Computer Science**  
*University of Toronto* | 2022–2023  
- Relevant coursework: Machine Learning, Data Structures, Database Systems, NLP.  
- Graduated with honors, focusing on healthcare data analytics and AI applications.  

Technical Skills  
- **Frameworks & Libraries**: PyTorch (model development), TensorFlow (predictive modeling), scikit-learn (baseline models), Hugging Face Transformers (NLP tasks).  
- **Cloud & Tools**: AWS (SageMaker, Glue), Apache Airflow (lightweight workflow automation).  
- **Data Handling**: SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy), REST API design (Flask, FastAPI).  
- **Modeling**: NLP (text classification, sentiment analysis), model deployment (Docker, CI/CD pipelines).  
- **Data Warehousing**: Basic ETL pipeline design using AWS services.  

Projects  
- **Clinical Text Analysis Tool** (HealthData Solutions)  
  - Built a transformer-based model to extract key phrases from medical records, improving data labeling accuracy by 20%.  
  - Integrated results into a dashboard for clinicians, using Python and Dash.  

- **Readmission Risk Predictor** (HealthAI Innovations)  
  - Developed a scikit-learn model using demographic and clinical data, validated with stratified sampling.
